cases.name: Ashley Nichelle Messner
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Ashley lived a life defined by her happy spirit, her adventurous heart, and her deeply soulful nature. She brought warmth and energy to everyone who knew her and approached the world with a vibrant sense of wonder. Ashley’s greatest joy and proudest achievement in life was being a mother to her two beautiful daughters, Rylee and Arya, who carry forward her bright light and loving spirit."
